concerns.text: US1 (Data Ingestion and Pre-processing) requires ingesting WCST data from public repositories that include a `stimulus_type` column distinguishing nostalgia vs. control conditions. Such archival datasets do not exist, making the primary hypothesis (nostalgia improves WCST performance) empirically untestable with the specified pipeline. This drifts the research question away from a feasible empirical study and effectively invalidates the claim that the project will determine a real‑world effect.
